summary: Weld County Sheriff's Office deployed Rescue 1 (Mine-Resistant Ambush Protected vehicle) for a 40-hour blizzard response from Sunday morning 3/14 through Monday night 3/15; deputies performed 32 rescues transporting stranded people to shelters, motels, and homes, winched out 8 stuck vehicles, assisted 24 more motorists, checked ~100 vehicles, and logged nearly 500 miles during the two-day storm with 3-4 foot drifts.
notes: Run 843 Chunk B (Unofficial Networks). Article published 2021-03-19; 'called into service at 8:51 a.m. Sunday' = 2021-03-14 (Sunday-verified). Notable mass vehicle-assist mission; precedent id 3345.
